_comment: Canonical instance-type catalog, shared by the management-api (name validation only) and the Go
deployment operator (resource + JVM sizing; go:embed copy synced via `make sync-instance-types`,
CI-checked by `make verify-instance-types-sync`). Both parsers ignore this _comment key.
SRE: to trial a type that is NOT in this catalog yet, do not edit this file first. Ship an
additional catalog (this exact schema) per region via the deployment operator config field
`additionalInstanceTypesJson` (GitOps: deployment-operator.config.configYaml in the
akka-application-plane umbrella values), then opt a service in by adding a top-level
`overrideInstanceType: <type>` to its ss-cfg-<service> ConfigMap config.yaml. Names must fit
g<N>.<shape>.<size> (use unoccupied slots or a spare generation, e.g. g9.*, for canaries),
status must be active, platform_default is forbidden, and names must not collide with entries
here. Once a canary proves out, promote its entry verbatim into this file, run
`make sync-instance-types`, migrate services to the permanent type, and remove the overrides.
Full runbook: operators/README.md, 'Additional instance types and per-service override (SRE)'.
Sizing policy: jvmDefaults.heapPercentage (50) fits containers under 2GiB, where 25% slack is
needed for metaspace and thread stacks. Containers of 2-4GiB pin heapPercentage 60, above 4GiB
pin 65 - bounded by the heap+direct <= 90% ceiling with the 25% runtime directMemorySize caps.
g1.general.small is the frozen byte-identity tier (pre-registry hardcoded values, every legacy
service runs on it): never change its numbers without staging a fleet-wide rollout.
Per-customer deviations from these defaults belong in KalixOrganization jvmSizingOverrides,
not in this file.
